<h2>Validate Provenance Columns of a Published Model Table</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Aborts when a published model table lacks a provenance column, or when a
checked row has a missing provenance value.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>validate_model_table_provenance(
  data_table,
  vec_required_columns = base::c("regularization_source", "candidate_id", "cv_strategy",
    "final_model_built_at", "variance_partition_built_at", "vegvault_version"),
  availability_column = NULL,
  table_label = "model table"
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_table">data_table</code></td>
<td>
<p>Published model table.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="vec_required_columns">vec_required_columns</code></td>
<td>
<p>Provenance columns every checked row must carry.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="availability_column">availability_column</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional column name. When supplied, only rows whose value is 'available'
are checked, so rows describing missing or infeasible models may leave
provenance empty.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="table_label">table_label</code></td>
<td>
<p>Label used in error messages, usually the table file name.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>By default every checked row must name the VegVault release its store
was built from ('vegvault_version'), so tables from stores built before
the release was recorded do not pass.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Invisibly, 'data_table' when every checked row has complete provenance.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>validate_model_table_provenance(
  data_table = tibble::tibble(
    regularization_source = "unit_cv",
    candidate_id = "candidate_001",
    cv_strategy = "grouped_kfold",
    final_model_built_at = "2026-11-16 10:00:00",
    variance_partition_built_at = "2026-11-16 11:00:00",
    vegvault_version = "2.0.0"
  )
)
</code></pre>
